title: Brand Guidelines
slide_intent: Give readers a recognizable entry point into the book. A cover can demonstrate the identity before the reader learns its rules.
strategic_value: Slack can introduce its working palette and illustration language in the opening image. The colored mark recurs on both the small signature and the dimensional tile.
demonstration: A multicolor Slack signature sits at upper left on aubergine. A white tile bearing the same mark floats above a black shadow beside the large two-line title.
practical_value: Use this composition to separate the jobs of identification, illustration and naming a publication.

content_islands.name: Signature
content_islands.spec: Place the horizontal Slack lockup in the upper-left corner of the full aubergine field.

content_islands.name: Illustrated tile
content_islands.spec: Float a white rounded tile toward the upper right. Put the colored symbol on its face and offset a dark shadow below.

content_islands.name: Title
content_islands.spec: Anchor the large white two-line title at lower left.
